messages:
From: laura.bennett@redwood.com
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SupplyCo — quick approval request for EOQ close

Team —

SupplyCo just pushed back their final signature citing a short data evaluation window. They're a high-propensity expansion account (forecast mid-Q1). Rishi had a discovery call last week and Jamie indicated that a 2-week trial extension plus a small credit would remove the last hurdle for procurement.

Request: can we approve a concierge credit of $6,000 (to be applied as platform credits over 90 days) + a 2-week trial extension? Attached is a usage snapshot and my proposed credit agreement wording.

Constraints: if Finance wants additional controls we can require a DocuSign amendment and limit how credits apply to dedicated vs hosted usage.

Rishi — can you confirm expected ARR impact and whether this needs VP sign-off? Ben — would finance be comfortable with the $6k one-off?

Thanks,
Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
From: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2027 10:01:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SupplyCo — quick approval request for EOQ close

Laura —

+1 on the ask. Quick context: SupplyCo is evaluating a multi-tenant hosted integration for their analytics team but the procurement team is nervous about short-term spend spikes in month one. The extension and credits will (a) let them finish a full ingestion test, (b) surface production latency metrics for us to baseline, and (c) materially increase likelihood of their Q1 purchase (estimated $120k ARR).

If we cap how credits apply (hosted only, expire in 90 days) and require a DocuSign amendment, I'm comfortable moving forward without C-level sign-off. I'd like to hold one clause: credits cannot be converted to refunds.

I'll draft the external email to Jamie so we move quickly if Ben signs off.

—Rishi
Sr. Account Executive
From: ben.carter@redwood.com
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

Laura / Rishi —

Finance will approve a one-time platform credit of $6,000 under the following terms:
- Credits applied to hosted API usage only; not valid for Dedicated/reserved commitments.
- Expire 90 days from issuance.
- Credits non-transferable and non-refundable.
- DocuSign amendment required for audit trail; please include a short usage clause we can cite for compliance.

I attached a simple amendment template we prefer. Once signed we can record the accounting treatment and move the credits through billing.

Approved by Ben Carter (Finance).

Hi Jamie —

Thanks again for the candid sync this morning. We want to make it as low-friction as possible for you to finish the ingestion testing. To that end Redwood Inference can offer the following as a short-term close incentive:

- $6,000 platform credit applied to hosted API usage (expires 90 days from issuance)
- 2-week trial extension starting when you confirm the start date

We'll require a brief DocuSign amendment to document the credit and expiration terms (Ben from Finance is on this thread and has pre-approved the amount). Credits are non-transferable and cannot be refunded; they only apply to hosted usage during the trial window.

If that works, reply with a preferred start date and we'll send the amendment and provision the credits immediately upon signature.

Looking forward —
Laura
